S.FORM: alang Ancoh ga niya mki sku Karing Keng atu Zosi go, kwara sali buwan nya ga 50 buwan, 112 hi ku kwara s'uli tayan. s'uli tayan pinspngan Gyencumin ga 53% kyan ku 59 hi, binah ga, 'yat kahun sku pinspngan Gyencumin ga 47% kyan ku 53 hi nya. pinspung na linhuyan Gyencumin ga, Amis 46%, Bunun 5%, binah lihuyan s'uli 2%. maki qu ngasal bziran. rhzyal kki'an tay 'llaw na Ancoh hya' ga rgyax. tay 'zil na Ancoh hya' ga llyung. tay mkyahu' na Ancoh hya' ga llyung. tay mkraya' na Ancoh hya' ga llyung. tay mkyahu' na Ancoh hya' ga Pacuya. rekisi kayal kyokay qalang Ancoh ga ungat kyokay. ssquliq pinlpgan ppqbaqan qalang Ancoh ga ungat pqwasan biru. tuqi 'san basu kisya' glgan spyangan na pinbahu Ubuy qqmayh
S.PHON: alaŋ an[ʦ|ʨ]oħ ɣa nija mki [s|ɕ]ku kariŋ keŋ atu zo[s|ɕ]i ɣo kwara [s|ɕ]ali βuwan nja ɣa ** βuwan *** ħi ku kwara [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan [s|ɕ]ʔuli tajan pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku ** ħi βinaħ ɣa ʔjat kaħun [s|ɕ]ku pin[s|ɕ]pŋan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ** kjan ku ** ħi nja pin[s|ɕ]puŋ na linħujan ɣjen[ʦ|ʨ]umin ɣa ami[s|ɕ] ** βunun * βinaħ liħujan [s|ɕ]ʔuli * maki qu ŋa[s|ɕ]al βziran rħzjal kkiʔan taj ʔllaw na an[ʦ|ʨ]oħ ħjaʔ ɣa rɣjax taj ʔzil na an[ʦ|ʨ]oħ ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ taj mkjaħuʔ na an[ʦ|ʨ]oħ ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ taj mkrajaʔ na an[ʦ|ʨ]oħ ħjaʔ ɣa lljuŋ taj mkjaħuʔ na an[ʦ|ʨ]oħ ħjaʔ ɣa pa[ʦ|ʨ]uja reki[s|ɕ]i kajal kjokaj qalaŋ an[ʦ|ʨ]oħ ɣa uŋat kjokaj [s|ɕ][s|ɕ]quliq pinlpɣan ppqβaqan qalaŋ an[ʦ|ʨ]oħ ɣa uŋat pqwa[s|ɕ]an βiru tuqi ʔ[s|ɕ]an βa[s|ɕ]u ki[s|ɕ]jaʔ ɣlɣan [s|ɕ]pjaŋan na pinβaħu uβuj qqmajħ
